name: Retro Bit Sound Designer
description: Designs, synthesises, validates and packages SHORT (<= ~1s) original retro bit-style sound effects for pet reactions. Renders deterministic 16-bit PCM WAV via Python stdlib (square/pulse/triangle/sine/noise + ADSR + pitch glide), exports OGG for Android when ffmpeg is present, writes an <id>.sound.json cue-metadata file, and validates duration, sample rate, channels, clipping, edge silence and manifest linkage. Never imitates copyrighted sounds; owns audio assets only, not visuals or behavior.
invocationHint: Use $retro-bit-sound-designer to synthesise, validate and package a short original retro bit-style sound effect (WAV + OGG + <id>.sound.json) bound to a pet animation.

runtime.requires: Python 3.9+ standard library only (wave, struct, math). Optional: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH for OGG export & deep OGG checks.

outputConvention: Write generated audio into the TARGET PROJECT (never back into AutoDevSkills/).
<sound_id>.ogg        # shipping format (only when ffmpeg is present)
